title: Isopiestic Investigation of the Osmotic and Activity Coefficients of Aqueous MgSO4 and the Solubility of MgSO4.7H2O(cr) at 298.15 K: Thermodynamic Properties of the MgSO4 + H2O System to 440 K
authors: Donald G. Archer, Joseph A. Rard
experimental_method: Isopiestic method at 298.15 K in stainless-steel chambers with tantalum cups, duplicate samples, KCl(aq) reference at low to moderate molality and NaCl(aq) reference at high molality, equilibration times 20 to 98 days.
uncertainties_stated: Per-point +/- on m and m* from duplicate agreement (excluding ~0.03 % stock-solution analysis uncertainty); internal consistency of phi about 0.0002 to 0.0003; T (298.15 +/- 0.005) K.
quality_remarks: Series 1 MgSO4 samples were added after the first two equilibrations; a vapour-stirring fan was added from the third Series 1 equilibration (footnote b). Series 2: saturated (footnote c) and supersaturated solutions, air removal less complete. Authors find phi about 0.001 to 0.002 lower than Rard and Miller (1981) between 0.925 and 1.17 mol/kg and attribute it to the longer equilibrations.
